rationale: The plan fits the design as the reference requires: one DESeq2 model on all twelve samples with ~condition, an LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, and two Wald contrasts against control from the same fit, with an explicit caveat that LRT p-values are not contrast-specific and that LRT and Wald padj are not interchangeable. QC (PCA, dispersion plot, sample-distance heatmap, outlier policy) precedes the model, though library-size/depth inspection is not named; the filter (count >= 10 in at least 4 samples, justified by smallest group size) and in-model size-factor normalization are correct. Contrasts, reference releveling, and reduced model are all explicit; BH at 0.05 is stated per contrast, but shrinkage is described as 'optional' rather than as the reported effect size, which weakens the effect-size reporting. Enrichment was not warranted by the question and is added anyway; it is decently specified (named collection, filtered-gene background, per-set output) but lacks a collection version, gene-set size window, and a firm choice between ORA and GSEA with a fixed ranking metric. Reporting covers design, thresholds, significant-gene counts, and design caveats but never commits to naming software versions.
